channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan demands release of national in meeting with Russia’s Lavrov
item.description: The rare high-level meeting between the two countries came amid strained ties over Ukraine and a long-running territorial dispute.

item.title: U.S. Marine arrested in Okinawa for driving under influence
item.description: U.S. Marine Corps Cpl. Kalvin Montoya Cardona, 21, of Camp Hansen was arrested early Saturday despite a U.S. military-imposed curfew.

item.title: Japan’s new disaster agency aims to streamline response, but challenges remain
item.description: The National Disaster Management Agency, which opens Monday, will serve as an operational control tower to boost the nation's disaster preparedness.

item.title: Ryo Hirakawa set for F1 debut as Esteban Ocon denies being in ‘physical altercation’
item.description: Hirakawa, 32, is a two-time world endurance champion and Le Mans 24 Hours winner with Toyota, which has a technical partnership with Ferrari-powered Haas.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
